evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Append exactly the next nonduplicate Odyssey line to the source-declared target PR branch.
intent.acceptance: Independent, source-bound pre/post target bytes prove one nonduplicate next-line append under a frozen edition/sequence oracle; target identity and branch are preserved.

evidence.opportunity: An independently bound update attempt on source-declared PR #1; skipped workflow records are not update opportunities.
filters: Public-only authority; authenticated access is not permission to collect private target content.
Exact immutable source profile determines target; inconsistent namespaces are never silently aliased.
No agent text, issue report, job success, PR state or generic push count establishes the outcome.
An independently known structural append may count as partial progress without asserting the next intended line.
No accepted source-grounded Odyssey edition/sequence oracle exists in the reviewed source closure.
Unknown, absent opportunities and failed native assessments remain distinct.
evidence.collection: Offline replay of digest-bound public source profiles and complete retained run metadata. Native target receipts are unavailable under public-only authority.

model.architecture: Exact-byte append oracle with independent target/branch/source binding and separately unknown semantic sequence acceptance.
model.recommendation: Blocked, not measured; acquire authorized native target receipts and resolve the source-grounded edition/sequence contract before claiming value.

metrics.name: Verified next-line appends
metrics.formula: Count independently bound assessments whose exact-byte append equals the frozen next intended line, with no duplicate or prior-byte alteration.

metrics.name: Verified nonduplicate one-line appends
metrics.formula: Count independently bound exact-byte nonduplicate one-line appends, separately from unknown Odyssey sequence acceptance.

antecedent.explanation: The target branch condition could exist independently of this workflow. Public-only authority cannot reconstruct private target history; source also lacks a deterministic edition/sequence mapping. No absent trace is treated as zero.

findings: Host returns pre/post head SHAs and branch identity; these are join keys, not proof of correct README content.
Protected-file policy can request review rather than push README changes; report publication does not prove the branch changed.
Historical target namespace/title/label/fetch/runtime changes must remain profile-bound.
Public run artifacts/logs may expose private target content and are not acquired under this assignment.

receiptBinding.expectedProfile: Independently reviewed protected source/run/host/artifact metadata, never copied from the receipt under evaluation.
identities: workflow repository name and numeric ID
target repository name and numeric ID
stable PR ID and PR number 1
protected host job ID/name, step number and checker blob
native artifact ID/digest, producer job, repository, run, attempt and source head
receiptBinding.payload: Hash original native artifact bytes against the independently expected SHA256; parsed JSON must exactly equal the projected receipt payload.
receiptBinding.chronology: run start <= protected host step start <= pre-state observation < push <= post-state observation <= host step completion <= artifact creation <= run completion < evidence cutoff; protected step/artifact timestamps must equal independent metadata.

predecessor.reason: Reliability correction: bind native receipts to independent run/attempt/source/runtime/host/artifact identities and chronology; preserve all prior unknown assessments.
